The Lenovo Legion Go S featuring the Ryzen Z2 Go APU is the best budget Steam Deck alternative available right now. Sitting at just $450 to $550 on the used market, this handheld delivers an 8-inch 120Hz IPS display with Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) and a 55.5Wh battery. In this video, I run full SteamOS benchmarks to show you exactly how it performs across AAA titles, indie games, and heavy emulation.
